title: Graph of symbol transitions with edge reads
summary: Each pair of consecutive symbols adds an edge to a graph; a probe follows the edge out of its node to name the stored successor.
core_idea: Add an edge per consecutive pair and read the successor along the probe's edge.

state.name: frelling
state.meaning: Graph whose edges join each symbol to the symbol that followed it.

readout.name: read
readout.latex: y_t = successor along edge of q_t
readout.plain: y_t = successor along edge of q_t

learning.few_shot_argument: Fixture only: no claim about learning speed is made beyond the toy case.

complexity.constants_notes: A handful of operations per symbol in the toy setting.

prediction.statement: One stored pair is read back exactly.

capabilities.prediction: Exact recall of the stored value at its own key, along its edge.
